summary: Ravalli County ground lookout on Palisade Mountain, built about 1930 and replaced by the Willow Mountain tower in 1966; no source describes the site today.

facts.status_note: The cab is gone. The Willow Mountain tower that replaced it is still staffed each summer.

notes_for_editor: Sources disagree on when the Palisade cab came down (1967 on the Montana Forest Lookouts history page vs 1969 on firelookout.com) and on where Willow lies from Palisade (2 miles northwest vs 2 miles southeast). The 1926 cabin appears only on firelookout.com. No source describes the summit today or its access, so no access or visit facts are recorded. No new photo URL was captured (firelookout.com credits a Fire Lookout Museum photo but gives no image link). Record coordinates match the Forest Fire Lookout Association listing. Fact-check 2026-10-10: the story said lumber and a 1926 cabin that stood from 1926, and attributed the 1967 removal to a newspaper; the sources say building material, a cabin built in 1926, and a Montana Forest Lookouts history line.
